authority_split.secondary_formalization: All equations, Lean contracts, implementation bindings, and experiment designs remain secondary until separately ratified or empirically supported.

elements.name: HSWM_HARD_CORE_CELLULAR_METANEURAL
elements.definition: HSWM is the larger semantic neural system in which typed stateful logical LLM cells execute as local nonlinear functions and operator-valued n-ary semantic synapses mediate later cell computation; HSWM owns persistent macro-state, activation, credit, acceptance, weight and topology change, and consensus is contained but is not truth.
elements.implication: Agent chat, vector retrieval, fixed workflows, scalar similarity, or cell count alone cannot substitute for the HSWM claim.

elements.name: HSWM_PROTECTIVE_BELT_TYPED_CELLULAR_CONTRACT
elements.definition: Typed cell ports, nonempty n-ary tails, fail-closed routing, self-similar macro-cell exposure, outcome-independent trace sealing, rollback, and one-class structural mutation are formal and engineering constraints around the hard core.
elements.implication: Lean compilation and runtime invariants constrain realizations but do not establish scientific efficacy.

elements.name: HSWM_POSITIVE_HEURISTIC_CELL0_CAUSAL_MEDIATION
elements.definition: Build the smallest three-cell system with one irreducible ternary operator synapse and bounded recurrence, then compare operator, scalar, shuffle, removal, strongest-cell and full-context arms under equal information and compute.
elements.implication: Advance only if learned operator W changes later frozen behavior, rollback removes at least 70 percent of the gain, and macro-cell exposure preserves public behavior.

elements.name: HSWM_NEGATIVE_HEURISTIC_NO_PROXY_SUBSTITUTION
elements.definition: Do not rescue the programme by relabelling orchestration, retrieval, extra calls, scalar salience, synthetic lookup, consensus, or type checking as a larger learned semantic neural system.
elements.implication: Negative or confounded causal evidence narrows the protective belt and redirects experiments; it does not become positive evidence by terminology change.

questions.body: With three frozen typed LLM cells, one irreducible ternary operator synapse and one bounded recurrent episode, does outcome-later learned W improve fresh frozen behavior beyond scalar, shuffle, removal, strongest-cell and full-context controls, with exact rollback removing at least 70 percent of the gain?
After hiding internal state and exposing the three-cell motif as one macro-cell, is public typed behavior preserved under composition without relying on fixed depth labels or private-state leakage?
Can a one-class topology mutation pass fresh, retention, complexity and canary gates and lose its gain under exact learned-edge removal, unlike the current confounded class-tag lookup?
Can only Agent A's accepted semantic-weight packet improve a byte-frozen Agent B on component-disjoint unseen work without transcript, prompt, parameter or cache leakage?
Can fast episodic weight changes consolidate into slow semantic operators while preserving rare exceptions, avoiding catastrophic forgetting and remaining exactly rollbackable?

Can one sealed programme jointly establish persistent macro-state, closed outcome-credit-DeltaW, W mediation, topology mediation, transcript-free A-to-B transfer, strongest-cell/full-context superiority, and retention/rollback?
